ATU publishes no aggregate cut-off for any HND programme, and states no site-wide WASSCE aggregate ceiling, so aggregate 36 was assumed. ATU's own HND rule is "six (6) passes (A1-D7) in all subjects including English Language, Core Mathematics and Integrated Science (or Social Studies for Arts and Business Programmes) and at least three (3) of the subjects must be C6 or better. The elective subjects must be relevant to the programme." The predictor cannot express "D7 passes plus three credits", so cores and electives are modelled at C6 — stricter than ATU's published rule. No elective subject is named for any HND programme. Diploma entry publishes no aggregate ceiling (D7 cores are accepted), so no aggregate bar is applied; subject requirements still apply.
